summary: Completed comprehensive testing of AutoMinsk car dealership website. All backend APIs and frontend functionality working correctly.
passed_tests: API Health Check - All endpoints responding correctly
Admin Authentication - Login/logout with correct/incorrect passwords
Car Catalog API - GET /api/cars returns 6 seeded cars
Submission API - POST /api/submissions creates submissions successfully
Admin CRUD Operations - Create, read, update, delete cars
Landing Page Load - All sections (Hero, About, Catalog, Europe Service, Contact) load correctly
Navigation - Hero buttons scroll to correct sections
Car Catalog Display - 6 cars displayed with images, prices, and details
Contact Form Validation - Shows error when name/phone missing
Contact Form Submission - Successfully submits and shows success message
Admin Login Flow - Correct password authentication works
Admin Dashboard - Cars and Submissions tabs switch correctly
Admin Tables - Both cars and submissions tables display data
Footer Admin Link - Links to admin panel correctly
